title: Packaging - Packaging of TV Picture Tubes/computer Monitor Tubes - Code of Practice
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 14312) covers Packaging - Packaging of TV Picture Tubes/computer Monitor Tubes - Code of Practice. This Indian Standard was adopted by the Packaging Codes Sectional Committee had been approved by the Light Mechanical Engineering Division Council. This standard is useful for the packaging of TV picture tubes/computer monitor tubes for their safe handling and transportation by rail, road and sea. Indian Standard PACKAGING — PACKAGING OF TV PICTURE TUBES/COMPUTER MONITOR TUBES — CODE OF PRACTICE

clause_2_normative_references.title: Pictorial Marking for Handling and Labelling of Goods, Part 2: General Goods

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
